From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Account Executive, Enterprise who will be responsible for generating new business pipeline and expansion and closing new customers in the Enterprise segment (Top Accounts in Germany). This includes identifying specific projects where Fivetran + dbt Labs can add value.

This is a full-time, remote position based out of Germany. 

What You'll do

  • Generate new business qualified opportunities by working with Tech Partners, SI Partners, XDRs, going direct outbound on named accounts in territory
  • Actively pitch the value proposition of Fivetran’s Database replication capabilities along with the Fivetran platform at-large
  • Manage 90-180 day sales cycles with multiple stakeholders and departments to land in an enterprise organization
  • Negotiate responsible deals and manage the procurement process with legal, deal desk, and deal champions
  • Develop trusted relationships with internal stakeholders and senior decision makers at large organizations who will evangelize Fivetran throughout their company
  • As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process.

Skills We're Looking For

  • A minimum of 8 years' experience in new business sales, demonstrating a track record of success in selling to enterprise-level organizations.
  • Have the vision to succeed
  • Plan the vision by a strategy through territory and account planning
  • Drive pipeline generation with ecosystem
  • Land customers as soon as possible
  • Sell services to help offload onboarding
  • Proficient in sales within the Data industry.
  • Capable of effectively utilising both inside and outside sales approaches to secure deals.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in generating new business-qualified opportunities across diverse channels.

#LI-LA1#LI-REMOTE

 

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

About the Role

The AI API Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical lead who designs and builds the APIs and platform capabilities powering Rubrik's AI-driven products and automation, owning the full API lifecycle across any stack, cloud, or iPaaS. This role delivers secure, scalable, high-performance APIs and full-stack services while enabling AI-native consumption patterns across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and own APIs in any tech stack - REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and webhooks - choosing the right language, cloud service, or iPaaS for each use case.
  • Build for AI use cases, exposing data/services as tools for LLMs and AI agents, and enabling RAG and agentic workflows.
  • Own core backend engineering in Node.js / Java / Python / Go, with strong data modeling and performance tuning.
  • Define API governance - versioning, documentation standards, and reusable auth/error-handling/observability frameworks.
  • Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring of engineers.
  • Define NFRs and SLAs for availability, latency, throughput, and reliability, and ensure designs meet them.
  • Partner with security and compliance to meet regulatory and audit requirements across APIs and integrations.
  • Lead technical discovery for new API, integration, and AI-enablement initiatives with product and business stakeholders.
  • Drive reuse and standardization through shared APIs, connectors, SDKs, and an integration catalog.
  • Evaluate emerging patterns (event-driven integration, AI agent frameworks, low-code automation) to shape the platform roadmap.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in API/full-stack/backend development across multiple languages and clouds.
  • 2+ years in a senior/lead/architect capacity owning API and platform designs for complex, enterprise-scale systems.
  • 1+ years in an FDE role, working directly with internal customers.

Technical Skills - API, Fullstack & Backend 

  • Deep API expertise across REST, including contract-first design (OpenAPI/Swagger) and robust error handling.
  • Strong backend and full-stack skills in Node.js / Java / Python / Go, plus platform-agnostic experience across cloud and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi).
  • Cloud-native development on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including serverless, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code.
  • Strong data skills - SQL and NoSQL database design, plus integration data formats (JSON, XML, CSV).
  • Secure API design using OAuth 2.0/OIDC, mTLS, and secrets management, with solid CI/CD and Git-based workflows.
  • SaaS integration experience with platforms such as NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, or Snowflake.
  • API Gateway expertise with platforms such as Kong / Apigee / AWS API Gateway / Azure APIM / MuleSoft API Gateway for routing, rate limiting, and policy enforcement.
  • API testing proficiency using tools such as Postman for functional, and regression testing
  • Networking fundamentals, including VPN/VPC concepts.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps practices and toolchains.

Technical Skills - AI & Intelligent Platform Enablement

  • Hands-on experience with the AI-assisted SDLC - using AI tools to design, build, test, and manage APIs. 
  • Experience building APIs for AI consumption, including function/tool-calling interfaces for LLMs and agents. 
  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain) and vector databases, and how they integrate with enterprise APIs. 
  • Understanding of AI-specific NFRs - latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails. 
  • Practical experience with AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) for AI assisted platform and infrastructure development.

Soft Skills

  • Proven ability to lead without authority, driving technical decisions through clarity and data.
  • Excellent communication skills, presenting solutions and trade-offs to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cloud or iPaaS certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP, MuleSoft, Workato, or Boomi).
  • Experience in regulated environments (SOX, FedRAMP) with strong auditability and change control.
  • Familiarity with event-driven/streaming platforms (Kafka, EventBridge, Event Hubs).
  • Hands-on exposure to AI agents, copilots, or LLM-powered features in production.

e4da53d905a47143.description:
Headquarters: Remote

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform teams within the Platform Engineering organization. This is a high-impact, high-visibility leadership role responsible for the foundational systems that store, ingest, and evolve the data powering ZoomInfo's entire go-to-market product suite.

You will lead a team of senior engineers across two core areas:

•       GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable), spanning scaling, performance, operational reliability, and the change data capture (CDC) systems that capture and propagate data change events downstream.

•       ZoomInfo Data Platform — ZoomInfo's analytical data store (BigQuery), including the ingestion pipelines and onboarding systems that bring new data in and keep it flowing accurately and efficiently, and the processes that ensure customer data deletion requests are handled promptly and compliantly.

This role sits at the foundation of ZoomInfo's data infrastructure — the reliability, scale, and integrity of these systems directly determine how fast we can onboard new data and how confidently we can serve it to customers. You will manage senior technical talent directly, setting technical direction, unblocking hard problems, and holding a high bar for engineering excellence.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

•       Lead and develop a team of senior engineers and tech leads across GTM Store and the ZoomInfo Data Platform.

•       Set the roadmap across both areas, balancing scaling and performance needs, new data onboarding velocity, compliance obligations, security and platform reliability.

•       Build a high-performance engineering culture grounded in ownership, technical rigor, and operational excellence for systems operating at large scale.

•       Manage senior technical individual contributors directly — setting expectations, providing technical guidance, and developing career growth paths for staff-level and senior engineers.

•       Serve as a trusted partner to the VP of Software Engineering, contributing to broader platform engineering strategy.

•       Establish clear prioritization frameworks to manage competing demands across scaling, new data onboarding, compliance, and reliability work.

GTM Store

•       Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable) powering the go-to-market data product.

•       Drive scaling initiatives to keep pace with data growth and increasing query/read-write demands from downstream products.

•       Guide architecture decisions to improve performance, latency, and cost-efficiency at scale.

•       Establish and maintain operational best practices — monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and incident response — to ensure high availability.

•       Own the strategy and architecture for change data capture (CDC), ensuring data change events are captured, propagated, and consumed reliably by downstream systems, including the ZoomInfo Data Platform.

•       Guide the selection and evolution of CDC tooling and patterns to support real-time and near-real-time data change propagation at scale.

•       Ensure CDC systems maintain data consistency, ordering guarantees, and fault tolerance under high event volume.

•       Partner with Product and downstream engineering teams to understand data access patterns and evolve the store's schema, APIs, and change event streams accordingly.

ZoomInfo Data Platform

•       Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the ZoomInfo Data Platform — the analytical data store (BigQuery) that consumes and serves data for downstream analytics and product use cases.

•       Own the architecture and roadmap for data ingestion pipelines, including those consuming CDC streams from the GTM Store, that bring new data sources into the platform.

•       Drive initiatives to ease and accelerate the onboarding of new data sources, reducing the engineering lift required to integrate each new dataset.

•       Establish standardized, repeatable ingestion patterns and tooling that shorten time-to-value for new data.

•       Ensure ingestion pipelines are reliable, observable, and scalable to handle growing data volume and variety.

•       Own the systems and processes that handle customer data deletion requests, ensuring they are executed accurately, promptly, and in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and related regulations.

•       Partner with Legal/Compliance and Product to evolve data deletion workflows as privacy regulations and customer requirements change.

•       Build observability and auditability into deletion workflows to provide clear evidence of compliance.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Enablement

•       Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements for scaling, new data onboarding, and compliance work that inform the platform roadmap.

•       Drive enablement programs — documentation and tooling — that help internal teams onboard new data sources faster and with less friction.

•       Represent the GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform in strategic planning conversations and technology decisions with company-wide implications.

What You Bring

Required

•       8+ years of progressive experience in software/platform engineering or data engineering, with experience operating at a senior leadership level.

•       Experience directly managing senior technical talent — staff engineers, tech leads, or senior ICs — and holding a high technical bar.

•       Strong working knowledge of large-scale operational (e.g., BigTable) and analytical (e.g., BigQuery) data stores and distributed systems, including experience scaling data infrastructure to handle high volume and throughput.

•       Experience with data ingestion pipeline architecture and change data capture (CDC) technologies (e.g., Debezium, Kafka Connect, Kafka, or similar streaming/CDC tooling).

•       Experience with data privacy and compliance practices, including handling data deletion / right-to-be-forgotten requests under GDPR/CCPA.

•       Demonstrated ability to balance platform reliability and performance work against feature and onboarding velocity.

•       Proven cross-functional partnership skills with product and business stakeholders.

•       Excellent communication skills — able to present strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership.

Preferred

•       Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data infrastructure, including BigTable and BigQuery.

•       Familiarity with event streaming platforms (Kafka) and workflow/pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, or similar).

•       Experience building self-service tooling that accelerates data onboarding for internal teams.

What Sets You Apart

•       You lead through people. Your strongest technical asset is your ability to hire, develop, and empower exceptional engineers — and then get out of their way.

•       You connect technology to business outcomes. You see infrastructure investments not as technical projects but as enablers of speed, trust, and better decisions across the company.

•       You are a systems thinker. You see the connections between platform architecture, team structure, process design, and stakeholder experience — and you optimize across all four.

•       You are decisive under ambiguity. Competing priorities, legacy systems, organizational change, and imperfect information don't paralyze you — they sharpen your focus.

•       You balance vision with pragmatism. You can articulate …
